support_page.title: Support & Help
support_page.subtitle: Find answers or contact our team.
support_page.footer_hours: Support available Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm.

create_invoice.question: How to create a new invoice?
create_invoice.answer: Go to the "Invoices" section in the sidebar, then click "New Invoice". Fill in client info, add products, then confirm.

add_product.question: How to add a new product?
add_product.answer: Go to "Products" in the sidebar, click "Add Product". Fill in information (name, price, stock, etc.) and save.

manage_debts.question: How to manage client debts?
manage_debts.answer: The "Debts" section allows you to view all indebted clients. You can record partial payments and track the full history.

export_data.question: Can I export my data?
export_data.answer: Yes! In the "Revenues" or "Clients" page, you will find an "Export" button that generates a CSV file of your data for the selected period.

pin_lock.question: How does the PIN lock work?
pin_lock.answer: Go to "Settings → Security" to enable or change your PIN code. The application will lock automatically after a period of inactivity.

reset_pin.question: How to reset my PIN?
reset_pin.answer: On the PIN screen, click "Forgot PIN?". A reset email will be sent to your associated Google address. Follow the link to create a new PIN.

print_invoices.question: Can I print my invoices?
print_invoices.answer: Yes, on the invoice detail page, click "Print" for a paper copy, or "Download PDF" to save it on your computer.

backup_data.question: How to back up my data?
backup_data.answer: Your data is stored locally in an SQLite database on your computer. It is recommended to regularly copy the database file to an external drive or a cloud service (Google Drive, OneDrive).

app_launch_issue.question: What to do if the app doesn't start?
app_launch_issue.answer: Try restarting your computer. If the problem persists, contact support via WhatsApp or email, specifying your OS and app version.

update_app.question: How to update the app?
update_app.answer: A notification will automatically appear when a new version is available. You can also contact support to get the latest version.
